title: 秋華賞の後に・冠、掲げて

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober seizes first place! And with that…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: She's won the Triple Tiara! The Mejiro family has once again claimed the glory of the Tiara! History has been made today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I won… I won the Triple Tiara…

text_block_list.name: Male Dober Fan
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dobeeeer, you did it! Hic! Congratulations! You did so well! Thank you for that amazing race!

text_block_list.name: Female Dober Fan
text_block_list.text: Dobeeer! You really, truly, absolutely are the coolest ever!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Dober! Dober! Dober! Dober! Dober! Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (I can't believe it! I'm so happy. I'm so happy! Oh no, I feel like I'm going to start crying…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (But…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Ramonu didn't cry, so I won't either!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (After all, I can hold my head up high and be proud too!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That was quite the race. You know…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It's hard to believe there would be another Mejiro racer who would be able to seize all three of the tiaras after you.
Hehe… Yes, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The next time we meet, you and I will be…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I go out to meet Mejiro Dober after she returns, amidst the crowd's cheers. Her expression is brimming with satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You too. Congrats.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Congratulations to you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Were you watching me out there? I bet you didn't even blink.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Were you watching me? Did you take in the entire race?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What you witnessed was the Triple Tiara we won together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What you witnessed was the Triple Tiara we won together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …Hey.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I've said this before, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you for believing in my strength, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We celebrate our victory together and take a new step toward our next challenge!
